description: Ratchet allowlist for tests/architecture/governance/test_cpp_include_direction.py. Each entry is a pre-existing include-direction violation against the fine-grained layer policy in tools/architecture/cpp_include_graph.py, identified by an exact (file, line, include spelling) fingerprint. The gate fails on any violation NOT in this list (including a line-shifted or re-worded version of a listed one, which forces a conscious re-review) and fails if a listed entry is no longer reproduced (stale-allowlist rot). None of these are include-path-only mistakes; each is a structural ownership coupling that the deferred T3 physical link-unit split (ef_core -> engine/mission/facade/content targets) is expected to resolve by relocating types or inverting the dependency, not by editing an include path. See the I38 registration entry in docs/plan/repository_consolidation/README.md for the full census.

entries.next_gate: Relocate the missile_seeker::SeekerEkfState/SeekerEkfParams value types owned by Missile into components/ (or a components-visible leaf) so models/weapons/kalman_seeker.h stops being a components dependency.
entries.reason: Missile embeds missile_seeker::SeekerEkfState/SeekerEkfParams by value (weapon_common.h:221-222); the seeker-filter state type is defined in models/weapons/kalman_seeker.h instead of a components-owned leaf, so the pure-DTO components layer reaches upward into a model implementation header.

entries.next_gate: Design the GPU/engine integration seam (opaque packet handle or callback injection) called out by the T3 track's 'link order and initialization' risk before WorldBatchRuntime can stop including gpu/* directly.
entries.reason: WorldBatchRuntime's interaction-broadphase compatibility path (run_interaction_broadphase_candidate_ids and callers) calls gpu::InteractionBroadphaseConfig/InteractionEntityPacked/InteractionQueryPacked and gpu::build_interaction_broadphase_*_batch directly; engine owns the call, inverting the src/README top-level direction note ('gpu -> core/runtime data packets ... no ownership of canonical world-step truth').

entries.next_gate: Move batch-of-episode-controller ownership out of WorldBatchRuntime (engine) into a facade/mission-owned batch wrapper so engine stops holding core/mission/episode types by value.
entries.reason: WorldBatchRuntime owns std::vector<ExecutionEpisodeController> execution_episode_controllers_ directly and calls clear_state()/import_state()/has_state() on it; the engine-layer batch owner embeds a mission-layer object instead of mission depending on engine, inverting the documented core/mission README direction ('may consume ... the public API of core/engine').

entries.next_gate: Same GPU/engine integration seam as the interaction-broadphase entry above; WorldBatchVisualBindingCompatibilityScene stores gpu::VisualRenderRequest/VisibleObjectPacked by value in an engine-owned public struct.
entries.reason: WorldBatchVisualBindingCompatibilityScene (declared in this header) stores gpu::VisualRenderRequest and std::vector<gpu::VisibleObjectPacked> by value, so the engine-owned compatibility struct's shape depends on the gpu packet layout directly.

entries.next_gate: Same GPU/engine integration seam; collect_scene_from_candidate_ids/render_scenes_batch build and consume gpu::VisualRenderRequest/VisibleObjectPacked and call gpu::render_visual_experiment(_batch_export)/render_visual_reference_cpu(_batch) directly.
entries.reason: This engine-layer compatibility helper builds gpu::VisualRenderRequest/VisibleObjectPacked values from ECS state and calls gpu::render_visual_experiment*/render_visual_reference_cpu* directly, the same engine-calls-into-gpu-helper-implementation pattern as the other two gpu entries above.

entries.next_gate: Relocate StepEvaluationBatchConfig/StepEvaluationBatchEnvState (or a contracts-owned equivalent shape) into runtime/contracts so WorldExecutionEpisodeStepRequest stops sourcing its config/env_state field types from core/mission/episode.
entries.reason: WorldExecutionEpisodeStepRequest's config/env_state fields (declared via the world_execution_episode_step_request.inc X-macro list at the end of this header) are typed StepEvaluationBatchConfig/StepEvaluationBatchEnvState, both owned by core/mission/episode/execution_episode_batch_prepare.h; removing this include as apparently-unused broke the ef_py build (verified 2026-07-20), confirming the contracts leaf embeds mission-owned batch-prep DTOs by value rather than the reverse.
